entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I purchased a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes, delivered back on October 9th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit or preference issue?

It's definitely a fit issue. I've worn them on several rides, but they're causing terrible blisters on my heels. I've also struggled to get the cleats aligned properly, and it's messing up my pedal stroke.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't working out for you. A comfortable pair of shoes is essential. Let me just confirm the return eligibility based on the delivery date.
Alright, I've checked our policy. Since the cycling shoes were delivered 61 days ago, you're still within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's a relief, thank you. Now, given the hassle and the painful blisters I had to deal with, would it be possible to add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase on top of the refund?

I certainly understand why you're asking, but since we are providing a full refund well after the purchase, that is the most we can offer according to our policy. We aren't able to stack a goodwill credit on top of an approved return.
Okay, that's fair. I had to try. A full refund is perfectly acceptable. What's the next step?

I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop the box at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued. Can I help with anything else?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
